entities.summary: Hugo Grenier is a French professional tennis player. Grenier has a career high ATP singles ranking of world No. 95 achieved on 12 September 2022. 362 achieved on 21 February 2022. Grenier has won five Challenger singles titles. He has also won six singles titles and three doubles titles on the ITF Futures Tour.
